prompts.title: Session kickoff
I like your suggestion
prompts.text: I like your suggestion — go ahead and implement it exactly as you described. If reality turns out different from what you expected, flag it rather than silently adapting.

prompts.title: Green light, go autonomous
prompts.text: You have green light. Proceed autonomously: implement, verify, and report back when it's done. Only stop for destructive actions or genuinely ambiguous product decisions.

prompts.title: Clean up git changes
prompts.text: Clean up the local git changes: look at git status and the full diff, group the changes into logical units, and commit each with a proper conventional message. Don't push. Flag anything that shouldn't be committed — secrets, debug leftovers, temp files.

prompts.title: Pick next task
prompts.text: Pick the most appropriate thing to work on next: check the roadmap or TODOs, failing tests, and recent session state. Tell me what you picked and why in two sentences, then start.

prompts.title: Wrap up session
prompts.text: Let's wrap up. Commit outstanding work in logical chunks, then summarize: what changed this session, what's verified versus untested, and the natural next step.

prompts.title: Push back if warranted
prompts.text: Before you implement: would you do this differently? Push back if this is a bad idea — I want your actual engineering opinion, not compliance. Then we decide together.

prompts.title: Investigate, don't fix
prompts.text: Investigate and report only — don't change anything yet. Tell me what's actually happening and what you'd do about it, then wait for my call.

prompts.title: Try a different angle
prompts.text: That approach isn't working. Step back, question the assumption behind it, and try a fundamentally different angle instead of patching the current attempt.

prompts.title: Verify before done
prompts.text: Before you call this done: run the relevant checks, exercise the changed behavior end-to-end, and show me the evidence — not just "tests pass".
